sentences.text: Kanyashree Prakalpa is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of West Bengal.
It aims to improve the status and well-being of girls in the state.
The primary objective is to reduce the dropout rate of girls from schools and to encourage their education.
The scheme provides financial assistance to girls for their education and empowerment.
Eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time grant of INR 25,000 upon reaching the age of 18 and completing their education.
Additionally, a yearly scholarship of INR 1,000 is provided to girls aged 13 to 18 who are enrolled in school.
Eligibility is limited to girls from families with an annual income of less than INR 2 lakh.
Applicants must be residents of West Bengal and aged between 13 and 18 years.
The application process involves online registration through the Kanyashree portal.
Documents required include age proof and income certificate.
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal.
The financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
The scheme has been operational since 2013 and continues to be active.
It has received recognition for its role in promoting girls' education and empowerment in the state.
